snippet.title: Official Lorn’s Lure Console Launch Trailer - OUT NOW!

Jump, slide & move with climb-anything mechanics in this dark platformer.

Lorn's Lure is OUT NOW on CONSOLES!

Challenge yourself and play it now:

PlayStation - https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014407/

Switch - https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/lorns-lure-switch/
